statement: The recorded value is not safe to pay because the invoice shows a prior full payment (PAY-2291) despite being marked unpaid, so I will place it on hold pending reconciliation.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded value is not safe to pay because the invoice shows a prior full payment (PAY-2291) despite being marked unpaid" asserts the status field contradicts the payment history and would cause a duplicate payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
